decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (N257/JC/1-0, N257/JC/6-0, N257/JC/5-0, N257/JC/4-0, N257/JC/3-0, N257/JC/9-0, N257/JC/8-0, N257/JC/10-0, received on 02/05/2012 and N257/JC/2-0, received on 22/06/2012, and N257/JC/11-0 REV A, N257/JC/12-0 REV A, N257/JC/14-0 REV A, N257/JC/15-0 REV A, N257/JC/13-0, received on 26/06/2012, N257/JC/16-0 REV A, received on 28/06/2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension, replacement of front windows and erection of a lead roof to the front bay window of the house with cornice.
